title: Shouryuu Sangoku Engi
overview:
A true historical simulation is born

With the tension only super real-time can deliver, existing historical strategy games pale in comparison!

Shouryuu Sangoku Engi is a historical strategy game set in China's Three Kingdoms era. Pick a scenario and a warlord, then work to unify the land. Time keeps moving, so rival states act while you make decisions - fall behind their movements and you lose ground.

Running a state means putting the right people in the right posts. Appoint officers to ranks in your court and army, manage your forces and deal with other powers through diplomacy. Story events play out in polygon scenes.

- Real-time progression
- Multiple events
- Official rank appointment system
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Memory backup
